title: Pairing preserves accumulated xor
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $x$ assign Boolean values to its variables, and let $P$ be a finite list of pairs of Boolean circuit trees on those variables. Suppose that in every pair the second circuit evaluates to the negation of the first under $x$. Replacing successive pairs in $P$ by the paired circuit construction preserves the exclusive-or of the first circuit in each pair, accumulated with false as the initial value.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of Boolean values to the variables
